about: Shared test vectors for the address and transaction-ID checkers: backend/app/core/validation.py (pytest) and frontend/src/lib/address.ts (Vitest, later). Both tiers must give the same verdict, kind and message for every entry. Entries marked serverOnly are checked by the server alone (the prototype has no length limit). Real addresses come from Assignment 2's snapshot and its D1 samples, BIP 173 and BIP 350; the rest are built with a throw-away encoder so that their checksum is valid and only the named rule fails.
